item.observed: Portrait: timer bottom 196px overlaps objective panel at bottom 168px, below its HUD layer
item.title: Phone players cannot reliably read the mission countdown — the timer is positioned behind the objective panel throughout portrait missions

item.observed: Portrait: timer at bottom 196px overlaps the HUD objective at bottom 152px
item.title: Portrait phone players cannot reliably read the mission countdown — the timer is positioned behind the objective panel

item.observed: At 740x360, a centered player at y=180 triggers 0.3 objective opacity
item.title: Landscape phone players see a faded mission objective while the player is centered — the HUD is dimmed whenever the player is below height minus 240px

item.observed: Returning after several seconds marks all elapsed notes missed and can fail the mission
item.title: Players lose The Pitch when switching tabs or taking a phone call — its wall-clock rhythm keeps advancing while visibility auto-pause ignores the overlay

item.observed: HUD shows Next plus five dots; leaderboard lists best times, not today's status
item.title: Players cannot review which five missions remain today — the objective panel renders only the nearest mission and unlabeled completion dots

item.observed: Pause menu heading is Paused, with no Bawalverse caption
item.title: Players see no Bawalverse name in the pause menu — its heading remains only Paused

item.observed: Enter in name field calls startGame() instead of opening character selection
item.title: Players pressing Enter after typing their name skip character selection — the name-field key handler starts the game directly

item.observed: Yulu briefing says 3★ par 1:15 but the mission requires 1:02 on Day 1
item.title: Yulu and Recovery players receive misleading three-star targets — their briefing pars differ from the thresholds set when the mission starts

item.observed: Pressing E removes a person from the remaining count before they leave the circle
item.title: Crowd Control can award success with people still standing in the circle — asking someone to move immediately removes them from the count

item.observed: A sixth slower Yulu run is removed from the five saved entries and shows rank #0
item.title: Yulu players see an impossible #0 leaderboard rank for a slower run — the current result is truncated before its rank is calculated

item.observed: Campus map draws curMission(), which is always empty for the five daily missions
item.title: Players cannot locate daily mission markers on the full campus map — it reads the obsolete mission list rather than the active daily mission state

item.observed: Reload immediately after payout restores the wallet but not its earned-day total
item.title: Players who reload after a payout get an understated day earnings summary — the mission save precedes updating the earnings accumulator

item.observed: The Pitch's roughly 20 seconds are absent from the full-day speedrun time
item.title: Full-day speedrunners receive a falsely fast result — the day timer stops for the entire playable Pitch overlay

item.observed: At 10 FPS a 100ms frame contributes only 50ms to mission elapsed time
item.title: Players on slow phones see mission timers run too slowly — the animation loop caps every elapsed frame at 50ms

item.observed: A v1 save with valid day/pos and mres={} throws when Continue calls forEach
item.title: Players with a partial save cannot enter the world — loadSave accepts malformed fields that applySave uses without validation

item.observed: A ₹90 roadside meal adds ₹180 to the day spending counter
item.title: Players see doubled roadside food spending and traffic fines in the day summary — those charges increment spending both directly and through the wallet-delta tracker

item.observed: After a mid-mission collapse, the failure sheet is open while S.running is true
item.title: Players can move and the day clock runs underneath the mission-failure card after collapsing — the crash callback resumes the game after opening the new sheet

item.observed: Day 1 Pitch schedules 32 beats at 96 BPM, about 20 seconds, not 90 seconds
item.title: Pitch players get a much shorter challenge than the promised ninety seconds — the rhythm sequence contains only 32 beats at 96 BPM

item.observed: Cutting a later required wire early marks it cut; it cannot be selected at its turn
item.title: Defuse players can become unable to finish after one out-of-order cut — a future required wire is permanently marked cut without advancing its step

item.observed: After reload guard hit counts vanish although the total S.ko is restored
item.title: Players lose guard knockdown leaderboard entries on reload — saveGame persists NPC hit counts but excludes guards

item.observed: Reloading the day summary restores the pre-summary save without the day-end awards
item.title: Players lose day-end prize and streak rewards if they leave at the summary — the payout is not saved until Start Day is pressed

item.observed: Items above the wallet balance are disabled with no insufficient-funds explanation
item.title: Players get no explanation for an unaffordable store item — its purchase button is disabled and the failure branch only plays a sound

item.observed: The trophy button opens only Speedrun and Knockdowns, with no earned trophy list
item.title: Players cannot see earned and unearned trophies — the trophy panel contains only speedrun and knockdown leaderboards

item.observed: With a person waypoint selected, the HUD stays on Navigating to during a mission
item.title: Players lose the active mission objective when following a map waypoint — navigation unconditionally replaces the mission HUD

item.observed: Sound initialization probes three absent assets/sfx/*.mp3 files
item.title: Players' browsers request missing optional slap recordings on sound startup — the probe references three files absent from the served assets

item.observed: Mission failure clears MX.cur without writing any failed outcome to the save
item.title: Players cannot retain a record that a daily mission failed — mxFail neither records the outcome nor saves it
